description: Get an authenticated transaction summary and the fee tier selected by product filters.
authentication: Authorization: Bearer <JWT signed with the CDP API key secret>

product_type.description: Restrict the summary to one product type.

contract_expiry_type.description: Restrict futures by expiry type; applicable only when product_type=FUTURE.

product_venue.description: Restrict the summary to one Coinbase venue.

wrapper_behavior: Canonical enums are forwarded under the SDK's exact parameter names. If all filters are omitted, the SDK receives no keyword arguments.
notes: Production FeeManager uses the two filtered requests above instead of an unfiltered cross-product aggregate.
The endpoint returns percentage fee-tier data; CDE fixed per-contract costs are modeled separately.
